corrections.proposed: 1934 built (first L-4 cab on a 40-ft wooden tower); 1954 replaced it with the present 41-ft tower
corrections.why: 1954 dates the present tower. The site has had a lookout since 1934, so the record should show both.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR's narrative gives 1953 for the replacement; firelookout.com and PNWSOTA give 1954, and NHLR's build field and Kuefler's early-1950s date agree with 1954. Recorded as 1954 with the 1953 date noted in the story.
NHLR says Mineral County; firelookout.com says Missoula County. The brief records Mineral, and NHLR supports it. Kept as Mineral and flagged; not resolved by any third source read.

sources.title: Lolo National Forest
sources.publisher: Pacific Northwest State of the Lookouts (pnwsota.org)

notes_for_editor: Brief's Mineral County kept, but firelookout.com says Missoula; the 1953 vs 1954 replacement year is not explained by the sources. Current condition is only as recent as the undated firelookout.com and PNWSOTA pages; the NHLR 'planned for restoration' statement is from 2011, and no source read says whether restoration has begun. Staffing 'early 1970s' has no exact year, so no staffed_last event is created. Access 'public' is inferred from PNWSOTA's description of current hiking access; no official closure notice was read. The Kuefler page is undated and was used only for the 1934 first cab and the 2005 lightning protection work.
